name: Signal Booster
effect: Sharpens the orbiter's link to the surface. The static between you and Earth gets a little quieter.

name: Cushioned Seat
effect: A real seat, printed in soft foam. You hadn't realized how long you'd been standing.

name: Warm Lamp
effect: Casts the orbiter in amber instead of clinical white. It helps more than it should.

name: Ambient Album
effect: Forty minutes of someone's late-night recordings. Rain, a distant train, a voice humming off-mic.

name: Field Guide to Birds
effect: Illustrated, dog-eared, annotated in pencil. Birds you will almost certainly never see.

name: Old Film Reel
effect: A home movie. A birthday, maybe. People laughing at something just out of frame.
